{"reason": "All 20 errors are false arbitrations; 6 of 8 shown rows have confidence <0.7 (0.44, 0.60, 0.61, 0.66, 0.67, 0.67). Adding high-confidence? as a conjunct prunes those low-confidence arbitrations while keeping the large-change/exposure gate, cutting false-arbitration-rate sharply while recall stays at 1.0.", "source": "(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
       (> inventory-exposure 500000)
       (high-confidence? edi-change)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))))"}
